# Manufacturer of Sheetmetal Aircraft Components and Assemblies - Wichita, Kansas USA
Welcome to H&R Parts Co., Inc. Est. 1955; Incorporated 1969 in the State of Kansas. We are dedicated to continued long term service to the United States Dept. of Defense as well as commercial customers and other local business partnerships. We have been supplying to our valued aerospace customers for many years, proving capability to meet customer requirements in all areas of quality, on-time delivery, and competitive pricing.
The scope of our Company is manufacturing of sheetmetal components and assemblies, spot welding, and CNC machining/punching for the aerospace industry.
Currently classified as a Small Business
SIC: 3728 NAICS: 336411
DUNN & BRADSTREET: 04-911-1594
Third Party Registered/Certified ISO9001/AS9100 QMS standards since 2013
Harry Ragland - Co-Founder (deceased 2004)
Established the Company in 1955 and spent many years building a solid business foundation in which we are still working from today. Mr. Ragland was a success in his Company and his life in general. He left the Company to his family, and we hope to continue Mr. Ragland's success and keep it in the family for many years to come by dedicating our same efforts.
Who We Are / Our Team / Our Office Personnel
Lon Legleiter, President/CEO
Started with the Company in 1977 and has worked his way from the shop floor to President/CEO. Expert in all areas of the manufacturing side of the business as well as the tooling, engineering, planning, and administrative duties. Lon continues to put all efforts into the continued success of the Company.
Brandi Chadwell, Vice President, since 1997, Contracting and customer support, planning review, purchasing, QMS, HR duties.
Levi Legleiter, Production / Safety, since 2005, Shop maintenance and safety, Production management, purchasing.
Kayla Howard, Administrative Asst., since 2015, Assist to all other office personnel duties, shop support, quoting specialist, data management, customer support.
H&R Parts is located on 2 acres, including 34,618 sq ft of building space for manufacturing equipment and storage.

text:
---
Our internal capabilities include:
FORMING - BATWING, BRAKEPRESS, SKIN STRETCH, HYDRO, HAND
FABRICATING PER CUSTOMER TOOLING AND OR H&R BUILT TOOLING
ASSEMBLY, CNC MACHINING OF TOOLING/PARTS, 5-AXIS CNC ROUTER
IN-HOUSE SPECIAL PROCESS: SPOTWELDING PER AWS D17.2/D17.2M (NON-NADCAP)
Our outside processing, all of which is performed by established approved vendors/sources certified for specific requirements, most of which are in the Wichita area include:
HEAT TREAT, AGE HARDEN, CHEM MILL, BONDING, FINISH, NADCAP WELD, GOVT PACKAGING, AND MORE!
See our equipment list below for specific capabilities and/or contact our office for any questions about any of our manufacturing capabilities.
We are a CCR/SAM registered company with Dept of Defense. We're also an approved source for: Lockheed Martin; Boeing, Textron, and many other indirect companies.
Supplying support for: C-130, KC-135, B-52, A-10, E-3, F-15, T-38 as well as many Commercial aircraft.
Defense Logistics Agency holds about 80% of our contracts for completed parts, about 10% of our contracts are general forming or other general customer specific orders, and about 10% are other indirect customers for completed parts.
